desc: The Beretta BRX1 - a revolutionary true straight pull reloading rifle designed forprecision shooting and hunting. The fastest manually repeating platform available, featuring an 8-lugrotating (16-lug for magnum) bolt head and lock-up system, ambidextrous controls, and a singlestage trigger for top-notch performance. With guaranteed sub-MOA accuracy, quick barrel, bolt, and mag swaps, and adjustable ergonomics, it offers ultimate flexibility for shooters.
